projects.name: Autonomous Self-Balancing Bicycle
projects.tagline: Designed and manufactured a self-balancing bicycle using a high-inertia reaction wheel and PID control
projects.description: Led the mechanical design, engineering, and manufacturing of a self-balancing bicycle capable of dynamically balancing. Designed and 3D printed custom mounts throughout the system, and designed a steel reaction wheel that was waterjet-cut and milled with a custom lightweighting pattern, along with a machined aluminum motor interface. Integrated the mechanical system with an STM32-based PID controller to achieve dynamic balance adjustment.
achievements: Led the complete mechanical design and manufacturing of the bicycle, including custom 3D-printed mounts and machined components
Designed and manufactured a lightweight steel reaction wheel and custom-milled aluminum motor interface for high-inertia stabilization
Integrated the mechanical system with an STM32-based PID control system to achieve stationary dynamic balance

projects.name: Baja SAE Suspension
projects.tagline: Designed wheel hubs, brakes, and suspension geometry for an off-road racing vehicle
projects.description: Designed and FEA-validated lightweight wheel hubs, sized the front brakes, analyzed suspension kinematics, and modeled CVT airflow for Olin Baja SAE's off-road vehicle.
achievements: Designed and FEA-validated wheel hubs under bump, jump, and tree-impact load cases, reducing mass by ~50% while maintaining a factor of safety of ~3, with a focus on Design for Manufacturing
Sized the front brakes and selected COTS components based on safety factor, braking force, cost, and fit within the rim
Analyzed suspension kinematics in Onshape and MATLAB/Simulink to minimize bump steer across full wheel travel
Modeled CVT airflow to predict internal temperatures and optimize guard geometry for a 90 °C operating target

projects.name: Soil Sampling Drone Attachment
projects.tagline: A soil sampling drone attachment for an autonomous fleet of drones to optimize watering of crops on farms
projects.description: Designed and manufactured a novel auger based soil sample sling attachment, primarily with custom manufactured and 3D printed parts.
achievements: Won Best Use of Drones at the Farm Robotics Challenge
Designed a patent-pending retractable slung-load claw anchor to secure the device to the ground during auger operation
Reached R² = 0.94 sampling accuracy
Designed a lightweight base optimized for stability with robust mounting points for servos
Kept the device below the drone's 680 g maximum payload capacity

projects.name: Soil Probing Ground Rover
projects.tagline: A retractable gantry that lets a farm rover autonomously probe soil moisture and health
projects.description: Designing a retractable gantry for the farm-ng Amiga rover so it can autonomously probe soil moisture and soil health across farm fields.
achievements: Designed a retractable gantry for the farm-ng Amiga rover to autonomously probe soil moisture and health in farm fields
Gantry provides a 20 in stroke, driven by a stepper motor and linear actuator
Probe reaches a soil depth of 7 in
Machined custom components on the CNC mill

projects.name: Robotics Software: State Machine, Particle Filter & Computer Vision
projects.tagline: Robot behaviors, localization, and vision written in ROS2 and Python
projects.description: A set of robotics software projects: a ROS2 finite state machine for a vacuum robot, a particle filter that localizes a robot on a known map, and a computer-vision eye-tracking system in progress.
achievements: Built a ROS2 state machine fusing odometry, lidar, and bump data so a vacuum robot follows people and drives a pentagon
Coded a likelihood-field particle filter using augmented Monte Carlo localization to solve the kidnapped-robot problem, converging in 7 update cycles
Tested the particle filter with recorded ROS bags in Rviz2 and in Gazebo simulation
Building a computer-vision eye-tracking system for hands-free cursor control and eye-strain break reminders

projects.name: Biomimetic Hopping Mechanism
projects.tagline: A hopping mechanism based on elastic energy storage observed in grasshopper legs
projects.description: Designed and manufactured a hopping mechanism with the goal of hopping >5 ft repeatably and using sustainable materials
achievements: Modeled kinematics and geometry in SOLIDWORKS, iterating for hop stability and repeatability
Fabricated prototype using laser cutter, band saw and drill press; refined geometry based on physical testing
Focused on environmental sustainability & low carbon footprint
